setup: Use existing Node, Playwright, ESLint, TypeScript, c8 and fast-check in bounded disposable containers. No dependencies, schema changes, git commits or production test data. Preserve scoped source snapshots, logs, screenshots, traces and release rollback image.
behaviors: A lost, invalid, timed-out or 5xx save response automatically checks saved state and returns success only for the confirmed matching stop or DVIR.
A 409 after a completed stop may recover by reading saved state; an uncompleted conflicting stop must remain an error.
Automatic recovery never sends a second completion POST. Failed or hanging confirmation preserves photos and pending reconciliation for explicit retry.
The entire status check is bounded to 15 seconds, including manual reconciliation; an unconfirmed stop never advances.
Confirmed photo-reference bookkeeping and post-save local draft deletion each have a 5-second budget. A local-storage hang must not prevent the durable server save or advancement.
Cancelling or switching driver sessions stops recovery and prevents further uploads or clearing a new driver's photos.
Draft photos are only deleted after confirmed server completion, and local-storage failures emit safe diagnostics.
Driver GPS arrival radius is 1000 metres, with warnings outside that boundary and unavailable GPS remaining unavailable.
HTML, service-worker cache and upload-module version advance together without changing the offline protocol or deleting offline events.

failureModel.duplicate completion: Unit and real-browser request counts, no automatic POST retry; manual retry gated by saved-state check
failureModel.false advancement: Wrong-job/incomplete history and missing DVIR confirmation retain evidence
failureModel.lost evidence: Confirmed R2 references kept in memory despite local cache failure; draft cleanup only after confirmed save
failureModel.hung storage or network: Controllable clocks, never-resolving boundary promises and actual-browser fault injection
failureModel.cross-session race: Abort during cache/reconciliation and late responses cannot complete the old session
failureModel.stale installed PWA: Version consistency and service-worker regression checks
failureModel.production regression: Scope release to exact live image, preserve all unrelated source hashes, test candidate and retain rollback

knownLimits: Synthetic Android Chromium and iPhone WebKit tests do not reproduce the drivers' physical networks or prove Cloudflare caused HTTP 0.
Browser timers cannot run while the operating system suspends the PWA. Recovery proceeds when execution resumes.
No automatic submission replay when read-only confirmation remains unavailable.
